thread_text:
Ava (PM): Quick sync — we need a short checklist for the new pricing playbook changes before we greenlight the feature flags. Key asks from sales: default quotas for Starter, burst rules, and clear contract language for softcaps. Can we assemble gating criteria?
Diego (Eng): Shortlist: 1) runtime capacity validation (p95 latency under load), 2) per-tenant burst isolation working, 3) autoscaler safety limits. Do we have benchmarks for Starter default quotas?
Lina (RevOps): Sales gave a pilot spec: Starter = 50k tokens/month baseline, 200k burst tokens with softcap + overage credits. They want a 14-day trial grace. Need billing behavior spelled out — how do we meter bursts vs baseline?
Diego (Eng): Metering-wise we emit per-request token counters already. Two questions: a) do we enforce burst at gateway? b) do we rely on post-hoc billing adjustments? Prefer enforcement to avoid surprise spending.
Samir (SRE): Enforcement at gateway is ok but need circuit-breaker to prevent eviction storms. Proposed rollout gating: staged for 5% tenants (low-qPS) -> 25% -> 100% with health checks at each step. Health checks: error rate < 0.5%, queue depth < 3, p95 latency delta < +30ms.
Priya (Legal): Contract language: softcap should be non-binding but documented as 'expected usage'. If we auto-bill overage, must be opt-in for pilots. Also flag: any SLA promises tied to a tier require refund semantics — need to define credits formula.
Lina (RevOps): For pilot customers we can make overage credits manual. For GA we need deterministic billing. Proposal: burst tokens consumed tracked separately as "burst_units" and invoiced at a separate SKU. That gives clear reporting.
Ava (PM): Good. Can someone draft the short launch gating doc (3 bullets max per owner) + a sample billing schema? We need it for Friday handoff to Sales and Legal.
Diego (Eng): I'll own runtime gating + sample quota YAML. Draft YAML snippet: ```
quota:
  tier: starter
  baseline_tokens: 50000
  burst:
    enabled: true
    burst_tokens_per_month: 200000
    enforcement: gateway
    softcap: true
    overage_sku: starter-burst-overage
```
Samir (SRE): I'll own rollout plan and observability checks. Telemetry events we need: pricing.tier_assigned, pricing.token_usage, pricing.burst_enter, pricing.burst_exit, pricing.overage_invoiced. Also add an alert when burst_enter rate increases > 3x baseline for a tenant in an hour.
Lina (RevOps): I'll own billing schema and SKU naming + migration plan for pilots -> GA. Lina: will Sales get a self-serve toggle to enable burst for customers?
Ava (PM): Sales self-serve toggle is intended but gated behind revops and legal approvals. Lina please include a manual override flow for pilots.
Priya (Legal): One more: include specific language for trial grace and opt-in billing in the pilot agreement template. I can draft a thin clause.
billing-bot: Invoice preview link: https://billing.redwood.example/pilot-preview?sku=starter-burst-overage (preview only) :mag:
Ava (PM): Final ask — can we add success criteria (go/no-go) for GA: 1) billing accuracy < 0.5% mismatch in pilot samples, 2) no regression in p95 latency for Starter > 25% of tenants, 3) clear sales-runbook and pilot opt-in flow. If you agree I'll collect owners and circulate.
Diego (Eng): Agree. I'll add the latency regression test and perf harness.
Lina (RevOps): Agree. I'll add one sample invoice to the GA checklist.
Samir (SRE): Agree. I'll prepare SLO docs and rollback playbook.
Priya (Legal): Agree. I'll draft pilot clause and a single-line SLAs appendix.
Ava (PM): Thanks — will compile and send the 1-pager by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
